maya: Quick design pass on Compliance > Data page. Triage before tomorrow's release: three small but important UX/accessibility nits around the encryption badge, retention display, and region selector tab order. sam: ok - drop screenshots or copy? will try to get a patch in today. maya: Screenshot attached in thread (see staging). Current badge label is 'Encrypted (KMS)' and tooltip is very wordy: 'Data encrypted using customer-managed Key Management Service (KMS). Learn more about key rotation and access controls in the docs.' It wraps awkwardly on mobile. rija: SR note: parentheses + acronym reads poorly. For screen readers prefer natural phrasing like 'Encryption: customer-managed key'. We can keep 'KMS' in the expanded docs link but avoid it in the short badge string. ada: Accessibility: contrast check on the green badge fails AA for normal text (measured ~2.8:1). Proposal: darken to #006644 or switch to dark text on light background with a 1px outline. alyssa: Also the badge is currently a (not focusable) — keyboard users can't reach it and SRs won't announce it. We should make it a
Encrypted with your customer-managed KMS. Only users with key access can decrypt. Docs
sam: good pattern. For SR friendliness use aria-label="Encryption: customer-managed key. Press enter for details" so it's explicit. maya: For mobile, convert hover/tooltips to an accessible bottom sheet on tap. Tooltip id should be kms-tooltip-191999 so we can reference from code. alyssa: Keyboard audit found another issue: visual order is Region select then Retention, but DOM order is reversed. Tab flow lands on Retention first which is confusing. ada: Repro steps: staging > Settings > Data > tab through — hits retention numeric input, then region select. This breaks expected linear flow and keyboard users complain. maya: Retention input also only shows a number (e.g., "90") with no unit in the UI; audit logs say 'Retention set to 90' which confused compliance folks. rija: For logs and UI please be explicit: show unit inline (e.g., '90 days') and change audit entries to 'Retention set to 90 days'. Also add an optional 'reason' field when admins update retention; include it in export. sam: I'll reorder DOM nodes to match visual order, wire aria-describedby, and change the retention input to include the unit suffix. I'll also update badge copy to 'Encrypted — customer key' and implement the button pattern. Any objections to #006644 for contrast? ada: #006644 is fine on contrast calculators. alyssa: I'll add automated checks: e2e to verify tab order, axe check for badge focus/role, screenshot diff for badge color, and audit log formatting unit test. maya: timeline: small patch today -> PR -> staging deploy. I'll review keyboard flow after deploy. deploy-bot: Deployment to staging scheduled by @sam at 1919993348 :rocket: maya: thanks everyone — small wins but big impact for accessibility/compliance. :thumbsup:
